lambda-zadd.title: λ-definition ZAdd
lambda-zadd.explanation: λa.λb.If (EqNat (Fst a) (Fst b)) (ZMake (Fst a) (Add (Snd a) (Snd b))) (If (Leq (Snd a) (Snd b)) (ZMake (Fst b) (Sub (Snd b) (Snd a))) (ZMake (Fst a) (Sub (Snd a) (Snd b))))

lambda-zmul.title: λ-definition ZMul
lambda-zmul.explanation: λa.λb.ZMake (If (EqNat (Fst a) (Fst b)) Zero One) (Mul (Snd a) (Snd b))

lambda-zleq.title: λ-definition ZLeq
lambda-zleq.explanation: λa.λb.If (EqNat (Fst a) (Fst b)) (If (IsZero (Fst a)) (Leq (Snd a) (Snd b)) (Leq (Snd b) (Snd a))) (IsZero (Fst b))

lambda-zfromdiff.title: λ-definition ZFromDiff
lambda-zfromdiff.explanation: λp.λn.If (Leq p n) (ZMake One (Sub n p)) (ZMake Zero (Sub p n))

lambda-ztodiff.title: λ-definition ZToDiff
lambda-ztodiff.explanation: λz.If (IsZero (Fst z)) (Pair (Snd z) Zero) (Pair Zero (Snd z))

lambda-qmake.title: λ-definition QMake
lambda-qmake.explanation: λn.λd.If (IsZero (Snd d)) (ResultErr Zero) (ResultOk (Pair (If (IsZero (Fst d)) n (ZNeg n)) (ZMake Zero (Snd d))))

lambda-qrepadd.title: λ-definition QRepAdd
lambda-qrepadd.explanation: λa.λb.QRep (ZAdd (ZMul (Fst a) (Snd b)) (ZMul (Fst b) (Snd a))) (ZMul (Snd a) (Snd b))

decimal-mixed-sum.title: Upper 1/3 plus lower 2/3: the exact number 1
decimal-mixed-sum.explanation: List(left L,right L,result L). Componentwise addition and its embedding in F give k=0 and rational base 1. This result follows from the declared interpretations and operations, not from the appearance of decimal digits.

geometric-decimal-reject-invalid-ratio.explanation: List(selected check name,candidate data,expected rejection N(0)). Decode the saved candidate and actually invoke the local checker, confirming that it rejects the violated formation condition or false claim. This is not a decision procedure for the meaning or termination of arbitrary programs.

sqrt2-state.title: State of the generator specified by the interval-generating label for √2

leibniz-state.title: Initial state of the generator specified by the Leibniz interval-generating label

label-with-evidence.title: Record retaining the qlim rule, arguments, specification, and evidence
label-with-evidence.explanation: List(rule reference,arguments,specification,evidence). This record describes checks of qlim responses; it is not a unified label required of every number or of T. Its evidence field refers to the written proof of Proposition 6.1 in the paper; this structural example is not claimed to have passed general proof checking.

label-pending-division.title: Syntax of division awaiting evidence of separation
label-pending-division.explanation: The call expression DivLabel(P,Q). Since the condition of separation from zero has not been satisfied, this is not evidence permitting execution as a label that satisfies the contract.

newton-state.title: State after one Newton update
newton-state.explanation: List(stage index 1,lower endpoint 4/3,upper endpoint 3/2). The product of the endpoints is 2.

separation-witness.title: Evidence data for a response separated from zero
separation-witness.explanation: (request 0,interval [1,2]). Only separation from zero at the endpoints is checked; the universal contract for the corresponding generative label is required separately.

zero-classification-zero.title: Zero classification: zero
zero-classification-zero.explanation: Node(0;). Distinguish zero, nonzero, and unknown. Computation evidence for specific classifications is included in proof-generators.

zero-classification-nonzero.title: Zero classification: nonzero
zero-classification-nonzero.explanation: Node(1;). Distinguish zero, nonzero, and unknown. Computation evidence for specific classifications is included in proof-generators.

zero-classification-unknown.title: Zero classification: unknown
zero-classification-unknown.explanation: Node(2;). Distinguish zero, nonzero, and unknown. Computation evidence for specific classifications is included in proof-generators.

alternating-rule.title: Finite rule data for an alternating sum
alternating-rule.explanation: A finite record selecting a known family. A proof of the general contract and checks at each precision are attached separately.

cauchy-modulus.title: Syntax of the error modulus μ(k)=k+2
cauchy-modulus.explanation: A call expression for natural-number addition. Its validity as an error modulus is proved in relation to the sequence concerned.

cauchy-center-radius.title: Center and radius for finite interval construction
cauchy-center-radius.explanation: (center 1/4,radius 1/4). Data for J_0=[0,1/2], obtained from the geometric sequence s_n=2^(-n) and μ(0)=2.

translated-label.title: Label retaining an integer translation
translated-label.explanation: (base-label reference P,integer −2). Translate the output value.

translation-arrow.title: Translation arrow τ(P,2;−1)
translation-arrow.explanation: List(base-label reference P,source integer 2,translation amount −1). The target integer is 1.

register-state.title: Initial state of the three-register machine
register-state.explanation: (instruction position 0,List(2,3,0)). Initial state for the input 2+3.

register-program.title: Complete instruction sequence for three-register addition
register-program.explanation: A six-instruction addition program using four instruction types from the instruction convention zero,succ,copy,jeq,halt. Its execution traces and checks are included in proof-models.

precision-field-epsilon.title: Full F precision request ε
precision-field-epsilon.explanation: Retain a positive element of F as an error request, distinguished from a request using the rational number 2^(-p).

polynomial-derivative.title: Formal derivative 2x of 1+x²
polynomial-derivative.explanation: Direct representation with the type specified externally.

polynomial-primitive.title: Antiderivative x+x³/3 of 1+x² with zero constant term
polynomial-primitive.explanation: Direct representation with the type specified externally.

polynomial-integral.title: Formal integral 4/3 of 1+x² between endpoints 0 and 1
polynomial-integral.explanation: Direct representation with the type specified externally.

beta-step.title: Record of one β-reduction step
beta-step.explanation: List(β-rule 0,root position,λ-term before reduction,λ-term after reduction,empty sequence of auxiliary evidence)

one-step-arrow.title: Arrow for one β-reduction step
one-step-arrow.explanation: (initial state,List(reduction step)). Distinguished externally from a general state type.

lambda-position.title: Positions for the λ-body, function side, and argument side
lambda-position.explanation: List(N(0),N(1),N(2)). Whether a position is valid in a particular term is checked separately.

status-normal-form.title: Termination status normal-form
status-normal-form.explanation: The discriminant part Node(0;). Actual traces also retain additional data.

status-step-limit.title: Termination status step-limit
status-step-limit.explanation: The discriminant part Node(1;). Actual traces also retain additional data.

status-stopped.title: Termination status stopped
status-stopped.explanation: The discriminant part Node(2;). Actual traces also retain additional data.

status-error.title: Termination status error
status-error.explanation: The discriminant part Node(3;). Actual traces also retain additional data.

json-null.title: JSON null
json-null.explanation: A format for conversion in both directions using tags and payloads. It is distinct from a direct number representation.

proof-nat-paths.title: General proofs of all 16 propositions
proof-nat-paths.explanation: Every key and value of the source file verification/certificates/nat-and-paths.json. Nothing is omitted from the basic-symbol file.

proof-lambda.title: All saved λ-calculus computation traces
proof-lambda.explanation: Every key and value of the source file verification/certificates/lambda-examples-v8.0.1.json. Nothing is omitted from the basic-symbol file.

proof-generators.explanation: Every key and value of the source file verification/certificates/generator-extensions-v1.5.8.json. Nothing is omitted from the basic-symbol file.

proof-models.explanation: Every key and value of the source file verification/certificates/model-extensions-v1.5.8.json. Nothing is omitted from the basic-symbol file.

type-t.title: Type T
type-t.explanation: Node(23;). An independent type of pairs (a,b) of F values, with multiplication corresponding to σ²=2.

t-zero.title: T value 0
t-zero.explanation: A pair (a,b) of two F values. Specify type T before calculation; integration with a sequence or interval generator is not required.

t-one.title: T value 1
t-one.explanation: A pair (a,b) of two F values. Specify type T before calculation; integration with a sequence or interval generator is not required.

t-minus-one.title: T value −1
t-minus-one.explanation: A pair (a,b) of two F values. Specify type T before calculation; integration with a sequence or interval generator is not required.

t-two.title: T value 2
t-two.explanation: A pair (a,b) of two F values. Specify type T before calculation; integration with a sequence or interval generator is not required.

t-sigma.title: T value σ
t-sigma.explanation: A pair (a,b) of two F values. Specify type T before calculation; integration with a sequence or interval generator is not required.

t-sigma-half.title: T value σ/2
t-sigma-half.explanation: A pair (a,b) of two F values. Specify type T before calculation; integration with a sequence or interval generator is not required.

t-one-plus-sigma.title: T value 1+σ

fixed-t-product-conjugate.title: Product with type fixed to T: (1,1)(1,−1)=(−1,0)
fixed-t-product-conjugate.explanation: List(type T, operation name Mul, list of two inputs, result in T). Decode all components as F values and recompute (ac+2bd,ad+bc). Check the previously declared type and the formation conditions for all inputs and the result.

fixed-t-product-sigma-square.title: Product with type fixed to T: σ²=(2,0)
fixed-t-product-sigma-square.explanation: List(type T, operation name Mul, list of two inputs, result in T). Decode all components as F values and recompute (ac+2bd,ad+bc). Check the previously declared type and the formation conditions for all inputs and the result.

natform-program.title: Finite NatForm program checking the formation conditions for the specified type N
natform-program.explanation: Node(2;Node(0;true),Node(1;),Node(0;false)). Instruction 0 returns a Boolean; instruction 1 repeats the program on the only child; instruction 2 branches on zero, one, or two children. A small evaluator reads the decoded program tree and executes the examples. This is not a universal type classifier.

natform-zero.title: NatForm(f())=true
natform-zero.explanation: List(specified type N, NatForm program, input to check, Boolean result). Run the recursive formation check on the finite tree and compare its output with the recorded Boolean. A two-child shape in f-only notation is rejected as a natural-number representation.

natform-successor.title: NatForm(f(f()))=true
natform-successor.explanation: List(specified type N, NatForm program, input to check, Boolean result). Run the recursive formation check on the finite tree and compare its output with the recorded Boolean. A two-child shape in f-only notation is rejected as a natural-number representation.

natform-pair.title: NatForm(f(f()f()))=false
natform-pair.explanation: List(specified type N, NatForm program, input to check, Boolean result). Run the recursive formation check on the finite tree and compare its output with the recorded Boolean. A two-child shape in f-only notation is rejected as a natural-number representation.

natform-nested-pair.title: NatForm(f(f(f()f())))=false
natform-nested-pair.explanation: List(specified type N, NatForm program, input to check, Boolean result). Run the recursive formation check on the finite tree and compare its output with the recorded Boolean. A two-child shape in f-only notation is rejected as a natural-number representation.

approx-value-error-bracket.title: Approximate value and error bound: bounds from interval endpoints
approx-value-error-bracket.explanation: (precision request 3 in N, (approximate value 17/12 in Q, error bound 1/204 in Q)). This is a rational response requested separately from a value of type T. The endpoints 24/17 and 17/12 bracket σ; their width is 1/204 and is at most 2⁻³.

approx-value-error-residual.title: Approximate value and error bound: bound from the residual
approx-value-error-residual.explanation: (precision request 3 in N, (approximate value 17/12 in Q, error bound 1/288 in Q)). This is a rational response requested separately from a value of type T. For q=17/12≥1, the rational residual bound |q²−2|/2 is 1/288 and is at most 2⁻³.

pi-rule.title: Pi rule: local identifier 0, specification version 1
pi-rule.explanation: (Natural rule identifier 0, natural specification version 1), read in its specified type. It names the Leibniz rational bounds and the two strict membership conditions. General cut laws and the correspondence with ordinary pi remain written proofs in Appendix B.

pi-recurrence-two-steps.title: Two finite recurrence steps: 1, 2/3, 13/15
pi-recurrence-two-steps.explanation: List(rule version, List(List(n, canonical rational text))). Recompute two recurrence steps from S0=1 and compare with the three independently stated expected values. This is not an induction proof for all stages.

pi-lower-witness.title: A left-membership witness: 3 < B3
pi-lower-witness.explanation: List(rule version, side: left 0 or right 1, rational q, natural witness m). Recompute the strict rational inequality q < Bm or Am < q. No infinite enumeration or arbitrary exact-equality decision is performed.

pi-upper-witness.title: A right-membership witness: A1 < 7/2
pi-upper-witness.explanation: List(rule version, side: left 0 or right 1, rational q, natural witness m). Recompute the strict rational inequality q < Bm or Am < q. No infinite enumeration or arbitrary exact-equality decision is performed.

pi-bracket-0.title: A finite pi interval response at precision p=0
pi-bracket-0.explanation: List(rule version, request p, index m=2^p, lower canonical rational text, upper canonical rational text). Recompute the separately stated endpoints and width 4/(4m+3) < 2^(-p). Large endpoints are finite certificate strings, distinct from direct unary Q syntax. The all-precision theorem remains a written proof.

pi-bracket-1.title: A finite pi interval response at precision p=1
pi-bracket-1.explanation: List(rule version, request p, index m=2^p, lower canonical rational text, upper canonical rational text). Recompute the separately stated endpoints and width 4/(4m+3) < 2^(-p). Large endpoints are finite certificate strings, distinct from direct unary Q syntax. The all-precision theorem remains a written proof.

pi-bracket-2.title: A finite pi interval response at precision p=2
pi-bracket-2.explanation: List(rule version, request p, index m=2^p, lower canonical rational text, upper canonical rational text). pi-bracket-3.title: A finite pi interval response at precision p=3

pi-located-left.title: Finite locatedness choice: left branch
pi-located-left.explanation: List(rule version, q, r, m=ceil(2/(r-q)), selected side). Check width < (r-q)/2, then choose a left witness if q < Bm, and otherwise a right witness Am < r. Recheck that membership witness. These two inputs exercise both branches, not the general theorem.

pi-located-right.title: Finite locatedness choice: right branch
pi-located-right.explanation: List(rule version, q, r, m=ceil(2/(r-q)), selected side). Check width < (r-q)/2, then choose a left witness if q < Bm, and otherwise a right witness Am < r. Recheck that membership witness. These two inputs exercise both branches, not the general theorem.

pi-reject-lower-boundary.title: Reject stage m=0 as a left witness for q=B0
pi-reject-lower-boundary.explanation: List(check name, candidate, expected rejection 0). Execute the local checker and confirm rejection of the recorded boundary, witness, recurrence, or version error. This is not a decision procedure for general exact-pi equality.

pi-reject-upper-boundary.title: Reject stage m=0 as a right witness for q=A0
pi-reject-upper-boundary.explanation: List(check name, candidate, expected rejection 0). Execute the local checker and confirm rejection of the recorded boundary, witness, recurrence, or version error. This is not a decision procedure for general exact-pi equality.

pi-reject-changed-witness.title: Reject changing the left witness for q=3 to m=0
pi-reject-changed-witness.explanation: List(check name, candidate, expected rejection 0). Execute the local checker and confirm rejection of the recorded boundary, witness, recurrence, or version error. This is not a decision procedure for general exact-pi equality.

pi-reject-false-recurrence.title: Reject the false recurrence value S2=1
pi-reject-false-recurrence.explanation: List(check name, candidate, expected rejection 0). Execute the local checker and confirm rejection of the recorded boundary, witness, recurrence, or version error. This is not a decision procedure for general exact-pi equality.

pi-reject-unknown-version.title: Reject undefined specification version 2
pi-reject-unknown-version.explanation: List(check name, candidate, expected rejection 0). Execute the local checker and confirm rejection of the recorded boundary, witness, recurrence, or version error. This is not a decision procedure for general exact-pi equality.
